source_evidence: User approved rollback after explicit audit confirmed five D308 chunks used fabricated, not executed RNG. Those five exact immutable blobs are void/audit-only under updated mode.json rng_gate and automation/rng_gate.py; no HP, deaths, stabilization, resources or action expenditure from them survives. Source is the accepted D307/308 preinitiative scene, original three monsters and terrain unchanged. Player preserved standing 'Roll for me until I say stop' (V dice only), psychic damage inherent Soulknife 2020, Ready main blade permitted per accepted ruling, and exact defensive plan 'Group together us and the horses and hold your attacks until they get within melee. Mara hide deep in the carriage. V will hold attack until one gets into melee with an ally.' Latest 'Same strategy go' authorizes proceed two rounds. Prior V/Cirren falling unconscious VOID. Actual visible python_user_visible execution previous turn receipt 909bc3243b51733dd39becae6445277c initiative V18+5=23, perytons12+1=13, Fenar7+2=9, Cirren5+2=7. Mara noncombatant withdraws into enclosed coach, no attack/check. R1 V moves to(10,-5,0) Ready thrown main Psychic Blade, trigger peryton entering ally melee. Perytons Dash from original positions P1(130,60,75)→(35,15,40), P2(165,-15,60)→(55,-5,40), P3(145,30,70)→(40,5,40), all within120ft. No attack. Fenar moves(20,5,0), BA Rage4→3 chooses magical Beast Claws and Readies one magical claw, Cirren(10,5,0) Readies Toll the Dead, concentration while readied. R2 V renews Ready, no limited spend. P1 dives >=30ft to within5ft Fenar(20,5,5); V natural1 misses, Fenar d20 7+8=15 HIT, d6 3+7=10 magical slashing (33→23), Cirren Toll WIS d20 11+1=12 FAIL DC16, 2d12 5,3=8 necrotic (23→15). No Reckless on reaction, no V SA damage on miss. P1 Gore8+5=13 MISS AC14, Talons6+5=11 MISS; Flyby rises to approx25ft. P2 dives straight >=30ft to (10,-5,5) toward V, Gore17+5=22 HIT AC19, d8 1+3+2d8 1,1=6 piercing V48→42, Talons5+5=10 MISS; Flyby rises to ~8ft. P3 dives straight >=30ft to(10,5,5) Cirren, Gore2+5=7 MISS AC18, Talons17+5=22 HIT, 2d4 1,3+3+2d8 2,2=11 piercing Cirren51→40; Flyby rises to~19ft. All reactions spent on P1; no OAs. Fenar R2 BA Shift3→2 gains6THP, no adjacent enemy for fang, renews readied magical claw. Cirren renews readied Toll the Dead concentrating (no slot). R3 V next, all three perytons still hostile (15/33,33/33,33/33); no retreat yet. All actual rolls in visible Python receipt 9d06eb2f3504a198da7b1765ff6ef61e, exact raw records attached; no unexecuted dice in replacement. V42/48 AC19, Fenar59/59+6THP AC14 Rage3/4 active Shift2/3 active MP6/6, Cirren40/51 AC18 all spells full, no other resources. V ActionSurge1/1 and SecondWind1/1 full. LongRest1→0/6 from actual damage and Rage, food21/feed28 purse391gp9sp6cp PixieDust1 all unchanged. Time same day~10:20 +12sec. Four horses healthy stationary harnessed, coach intact, Mara sheltered. Preserve all earlier accepted travel, quests, custody and rule corrections. Await V round3 choice.
